evt.850.104th_graduation.body: The training camp holds the graduation of the 104th Training Corps (class of 850). The top ten in the rankings may join the Military Police and live in the safety of Sina; the others choose between the Garrison and the Survey Corps. The high command can weigh on where the best are assigned.
evt.850.104th_graduation.choice.corps: Let each choose, with no pressure on the best
evt.850.104th_graduation.choice.brigade: Push the best towards the Military Police
evt.850.104th_graduation.choice.garnison: Keep the best in the Garrison
evt.850.trost_breach.body: The Colossal Titan reappears above Trost, five years after Shiganshina. The district's outer gate is broken through; Titans enter the streets. The Garrison and the trainees of the 104th are in the city.
evt.850.trost_breach.choice.evacuer: Order the evacuation and hold the streets until it is complete
evt.850.trost_breach.choice.tenir_porte: Throw everything in front of the gate
evt.850.trost_breach.choice.mobiliser: Put the 104th in the front line at once
evt.850.trost_defense.body: The Garrison and 104th squads hold the rooftops while the population is evacuated. The supply depot, surrounded, leaves the soldiers without gas. Losses among the trainees are heavy. Two Titans are captured alive for study.
evt.850.trost_defense.choice.secteur: Sacrifice one sector to save the rest
evt.850.eren_first_transformation.body: A Titan attacks the other Titans in the middle of Trost. When it collapses, Eren Yeager emerges from the nape. The Garrison holds him at gunpoint; a man of the 104th could thus become a Titan, and the high command must decide whether to let him act or set him aside.
evt.850.eren_first_transformation.choice: Keep him out of the fight, under guard
evt.850.trost_plug.body: Commander Pixis approves a plan: plug the breach with a boulder carried by Eren's Titan, while the soldiers lure the Titans into a corner of the city. The operation can also be attempted without him, at great cost, or Trost can be abandoned.
evt.850.trost_plug.choice.sans_eren: Try to plug the breach without him
evt.850.trost_plug.choice.abandonner: Abandon Trost and close the road to Rose
evt.850.eren_trial.body: The military tribunal, presided over by Commander-in-Chief Zackly, must decide who keeps Eren Yeager. The Military Police want to study him and then eliminate him; Erwin Smith asks that he join the Survey Corps and go beyond the Walls with him.
evt.850.eren_trial.choice.corps: Entrust Eren to the Survey Corps
evt.850.eren_trial.choice.brigade: Hand him over to the Military Police
evt.850.eren_trial.choice.garnison: Place him in the Garrison's custody
evt.850.branch_choice.body: The survivors of the 104th choose their branch after the night that follows Erwin's address. Several join the Survey Corps, some of whom had not planned to.
evt.850.expedition57_preparation.body: Erwin Smith prepares the 57th expedition beyond the Walls, from Karanes towards Shiganshina. He has restraint weapons made in secret and adopts the long-range scouting formation.
evt.850.expedition57.body: The 57th expedition sets out from Karanes. On the right wing, a human-looking Titan cuts through the formation, ignores the other soldiers and searches for someone. Black flares go up one after another; losses on the right wing are heavy.
evt.850.giant_tree_forest.body: Erwin leads the centre of the formation into the Forest of Giant Trees and sets a trap: restraint weapons immobilise the Female Titan. The capture narrowly fails: the Titan calls the others to devour it and escapes.
evt.850.giant_tree_forest.choice.piege: Set the trap in the forest
evt.850.giant_tree_forest.choice.arriere: Sacrifice the rearguard to buy time
evt.850.special_squad_loss.body: Captain Levi's special squad escorts Eren out of the forest. The Female Titan catches up with it; Petra, Oluo, Eld and Gunther are killed.
evt.850.traitor_investigation.body: The expedition's return is a public failure. Erwin and Armin conclude that the Female Titan knew Eren's face and so came from the 104th. Armin suspects Annie Leonhart, assigned to the Military Police in Stohess.
evt.850.stohess_capture.body: The Corps tries to lure Annie Leonhart into an underground passage in Stohess during Eren's transfer to the capital. She refuses to go down and transforms in the middle of the street. The fight between the two Titans ravages the district.
evt.850.stohess_capture.choice.piege_urb: Set the trap in the city
evt.850.stohess_capture.choice.evacuer: Evacuate the quarter before the trap
evt.850.stohess_capture.choice.arrestati: Arrest her without a fight, with proof in hand
evt.850.annie_crystallization.body: Defeated, Annie Leonhart encases herself in a crystal that nothing can scratch. The Survey Corps has her moved underground.
evt.850.annie_crystallization.choice.sou: Keep her in the Corps' underground vaults
evt.850.annie_crystallization.choice.bri: Entrust her to the Military Police
evt.850.wall_titan_discovery.body: The fight in Stohess has torn away a section of Wall Sina. In the breach, a Titan's face can be seen set in the stone. Pastor Nick, of the Cult of the Walls, begs that the face be covered and kept out of the sun.
evt.850.wall_titan_discovery.choice.cens: Cover the breach and keep the discovery quiet
evt.850.wall_rose_invasion.body: Titans are reported inside Wall Rose, to the south. Mike Zacharias holds back a group of Titans to cover his men; he is killed by Titans accompanied by a Beast Titan that can speak. No breach is found.
evt.850.wall_rose_invasion.choice.recher: Search for the breach along the wall
evt.850.wall_rose_invasion.choice.redepl: Redeploy the Garrison to the south
evt.850.ragako.body: Connie Springer finds his home village of Ragako empty, the houses destroyed from within. A Titan unable to move lies on the roof of his family's house.
evt.850.ragako.choice.detruire: Raze the village and hush the matter up
evt.850.utgard_battle.body: The group sheltering in the ruined castle of Utgard is attacked at night, when Titans should be inactive. The tower is held until the gas runs out; Nanaba and Gelgar are killed. Ymir transforms to defend her comrades.
evt.850.utgard_battle.choice.tenir: Hold the tower until reinforcements arrive
evt.850.utgard_battle.choice.diversion: Create a diversion to draw the Titans away
evt.850.ymir_historia_revelations.body: Ymir holds a Titan power. Krista Lenz reveals that her name is Historia Reiss. Atop the wall, Reiner Braun and Bertholdt Hoover confess to Eren that they are the Armored Titan and the Colossal Titan.
evt.850.armored_colossal_fight.body: The Armored and Colossal Titans abduct Eren and Ymir and flee towards the forest. Erwin launches a pursuit with the Garrison and the Military Police. Eren is recovered at the cost of many lives; Hannes is killed by a Titan before Eren's and Mikasa's eyes. Ymir leaves with Reiner and Bertholdt.
evt.850.armored_colossal_fight.choice.po: Pursue the abductors at any cost
evt.850.armored_colossal_fight.choice.pr: Protect the wall and give up the pursuit
evt.850.armored_colossal_fight.choice.ar: Arrest Reiner and Bertholdt before they strike
evt.850.sina_gates_closed.body: During Erwin's trial, a false message announces the fall of Wall Rose. The royal council orders the gates of Sina closed to protect the capital and refuses to shelter the inhabitants of Rose.
evt.850.sina_gates_closed.choice.ouvrir: Open the gates to the inhabitants of Rose
evt.850.survey_corps_hunted.body: The Interior Police of the Military Police have the Survey Corps accused of a murder it did not commit and obtain an order to arrest its members. The Corps scatters and goes into hiding.
evt.850.survey_corps_hunted.choice.se_ca: Hide and carry on in secret
evt.850.levi_kenny_street_fight.body: Kenny Ackerman and the Interior Police's anti-personnel squad attack Levi's team in the city. Their ODM gear carries firearms designed for use against humans. Levi escapes.
evt.850.erwin_trial.body: Erwin Smith appears before King Fritz and Commander-in-Chief Zackly. During the hearing, the announcement of the fall of Wall Rose exposes the royal council's attitude. Zackly turns the tables: the trial becomes the occasion for the coup.
evt.850.erwin_trial.choice.defense_publi: Defend publicly, stake all on the truth
evt.850.coup.body: With the backing of Zackly, Pixis and Nile Dok, the royal government is overthrown without a battle: King Fritz was a decoy and the nobles of the council are arrested. The true king has yet to be found.
evt.850.reiss_chapel.body: In the cavern beneath the Reiss chapel, Rod Reiss urges Historia to become a Titan and devour Eren to recover the royal family's power. Historia refuses and frees Eren.
evt.850.reiss_chapel.choice.affronter: Go down into the cavern and confront Rod Reiss
evt.850.rod_reiss_titan.body: Rod Reiss, now an Abnormal some hundred and twenty metres tall, crawls towards the district of Orvud. Kenny Ackerman, mortally wounded in the collapse of the cavern, hands a dose of serum to Levi before dying. Historia strikes the final blow against the Titan.
evt.850.rod_reiss_titan.choice.combattre: Give battle on the wall of Orvud
evt.850.rod_reiss_titan.choice.evacuer: Evacuate Orvud and abandon the district
evt.850.historia_coronation.body: Historia Reiss is crowned Queen of the Walls. Real power passes to the army. Historia opens orphanages for the children of the slums.
evt.850.historia_coronation.choice.conse: Let the Survey Corps advise the queen
Place Pixis at the queen's side
evt.850.historia_coronation.choice.regen: Establish a regency of the nobility
evt.850.police_tech_seized.body: The Interior Police's workshops and archives are seized. They reveal that industry has been held back for generations. Hange sets to work on a weapon able to pierce hardened armour.
evt.850.police_tech_seized.choice.partag: Share them among the three branches
evt.850.shiganshina_preparations.body: Erwin prepares the retaking of Wall Maria: a night march to Shiganshina, Eren is to plug the breach by hardening, the thunder spears are handed out. A spy could ruin everything.
evt.850.shiganshina_battle.body: Eren plugs the Shiganshina gate, but the Beast Titan and dozens of Titans block the retreat, while the Armored and Colossal Titans attack the wall.
evt.850.thunder_spears_first_use.body: The thunder spears pierce the hardened armour of the Armored Titan: their first use in combat.
evt.850.erwin_charge.body: To give Levi a chance to reach the Beast Titan, Erwin leads the recruits in a cavalry charge under the rocks hurled by the Titan. Almost all of them fall; Erwin is mortally wounded.
evt.850.serum_choice.body: A single dose of serum, the one Kenny passed on. Erwin is dying; so is Armin, burned by the Colossal Titan. Whoever receives it will devour Bertholdt and inherit the Colossal Titan.
evt.845.wall_maria_gate: Fall of the Wall Maria gate
evt.851.marley_ships_lost: Loss of the Marleyan reconnaissance ships
evt.854.yeagerist_coup: Yeagerist coup and assassination of Zackly
evt.gen.disette_locale.body: The granaries of {province} are empty before the harvest. Families have been queuing outside the market hall since dawn.
evt.gen.rumeur_mur.body: In {province}, people whisper that a crack is opening in the wall and that the Garrison is hiding it.
evt.gen.rumeur_mur.choice.pretres: Let the priests of the Cult reassure the crowd
evt.gen.greve_mines.body: The miners in the hills stop work: they demand payment for the days owed since winter.
evt.gen.greve_mines.choice.garnison: Send the Garrison to reopen the galleries
evt.gen.epidemie.body: A fever is spreading through the lower quarters of {province}. The doctors lack everything.
evt.gen.mariage_notable.body: Two great merchant families of Sina are joined in marriage. The ceremony draws the whole court.
evt.gen.fete_moisson.body: The harvest is in at {province}. The inhabitants want to celebrate the end of the work despite the restrictions.
evt.gen.fete_moisson.choice.sobre: Urge restraint and store the grain
evt.gen.incendie.body: A fire has destroyed a block of houses in {province}. Families are sleeping in the street.
evt.gen.incendie.choice.enquete: Open an inquiry into the cause of the fire
evt.gen.refugies_tensions.body: In {province}, refugees from Maria and local inhabitants have fought over access to the well.
evt.gen.desertion.body: About ten Garrison soldiers have left their post at night, taking their equipment.
evt.gen.desertion.choice.pardon: Offer a pardon to those who return
evt.gen.accident_odm.body: During training, an ODM gear cable gave way. {name} witnessed the fall.
evt.gen.vol_gaz.body: Gas canisters are missing from a depot's inventory. The register has been altered by hand.
evt.gen.vol_gaz.choice.brigade: Hand the case to the Military Police
evt.gen.duel_officiers.body: {name} has been challenged to a duel by an officer of another branch, over an insult uttered in the mess.
evt.gen.mutinerie_poste.body: The garrison of a wall post at {province} refuses to stand guard: it has received no food for two weeks.
evt.gen.recrues_volontaires.body: After the latest news, young people are turning up at the training camp to enlist.
evt.gen.recrues_volontaires.choice.refus: Send them back to their fields
evt.gen.scandale_noble.body: A Mitras newspaper reveals that a noble of the council is reselling reserve food at extortionate prices.
evt.gen.scandale_noble.choice.etouffer: Hush the affair up in exchange for a favour
evt.gen.petition.body: The inhabitants of {province} send a petition to the cabinet: they ask for the grain tax to be suspended.
evt.gen.proces_local.body: The court of {province} must try a bread thief. The courtroom is full.
evt.gen.lettre_anonyme.body: An anonymous letter accuses {name} of corresponding with merchants in the capital for personal gain.
evt.gen.sermon_culte.body: In {province}, a priest of the Cult of the Walls preaches that the Walls are a divine gift and that leaving them is sacrilege.
evt.gen.deuil.body: {name} has just learned of the death of someone close, who had stayed in a village in Rose.
evt.gen.promotion.body: {name}'s service record warrants a promotion. Their branch requests it.
evt.gen.confession.body: {name} asks for a private audience: something has weighed on their conscience since the last sortie.
evt.gen.epuisement.body: The corps doctor reports that {name} no longer sleeps and refuses to leave their office.
evt.gen.anormal_signale.body: A Titan behaving strangely is moving along the wall near {province}. It does not move away.
evt.gen.anormal_signale.choice.reconnais: Send a reconnaissance from the top of the wall
evt.gen.attaque_nocturne.body: Last night, under the moon, Titans came up to the foot of the wall at {province}. The watchmen were not expecting them.
evt.gen.attaque_nocturne.choice.feux: Light fires along the wall walk
evt.gen.ruines_decouvertes: Objects from the ruins of Maria
evt.gen.ruines_decouvertes.body: A patrol brings back objects found in the ruins of a village in Maria: tools, registers, a diary.
evt.gen.ruines_decouvertes.choice.archiv: Hand them over to the Corps archives
evt.gen.ruines_decouvertes.choice.culte: Entrust them to the Cult of the Walls
evt.gen.tempete.body: A hailstorm has flattened the wheat around {province}.
evt.gen.hiver_rude.body: Winter has come early. Firewood is already running short in the outskirts.
evt.gen.rumeur_exterieur.body: A merchant claims to have seen, from the top of the wall, smoke far beyond Maria.
evt.gen.espion_suppose.body: The Military Police report a man noting down the changing of the guard on Wall Sina.
tech.tech_odm_antipersonnel.sheet: Built-in firearms; for use against humans.
tech.tech_antihardening_doctrine.sheet: Bonus against the Armored and Female Titans.
tech.tech_ports_navy.sheet: Coastal ships; access to the outside.
tech.tech_aerial_reconnaissance.sheet: Dated maps; reduced fog of war.
tech.tech_antititan_rifle.sheet: Increased damage against Titans (Pure Titans, shifters).
tech.tech_chemical_weapons.sheet: A fearsome weapon, at a heavy moral cost.
tech.tech_titan_projection.sheet: The shifter as a strategic weapon.
tech.tech_doctrine_agile.sheet: Mobile defence style: ODM gear and light squads.
tech.tech_doctrine_fortification.sheet: Static defence style: walls and cannons.
tech.tech_doctrine_capture.sheet: Research advances faster; sorties expose the men more.
tech.tech_doctrine_elimination.sheet: Sorties kill without trying to capture: fewer losses.
tech.tech_doctrine_transparency.sheet: The regime publishes what it knows: legitimacy rises, the Cult declines.
tech.tech_doctrine_censorship.sheet: The regime controls information: the Cult is strengthened, legitimacy eroded.

chron.choice_why: Non-historical choice: a share of the event's weight is added to the divergence.

intel.report_cert_why: Certainty of a report: “rumour” for an unreliable agent, “clue” for a competent one. A report may be false.
intel.check.non_verifie_why: No direct observation has cross-checked it yet.
intel.check.confirme_why: A direct observation (expedition, watchtower) or a revelation has confirmed it.
intel.check.dementi_why: A direct observation or a revelation has contradicted it: the report was false.

intel.loyalty_why: Loyalty: a disloyal agent can be turned; they then keep reporting, and deceiving.
intel.skill_why: Skill: chance of finding what is hidden; below 50, reports are more often false.

research.captured_why: Titans captured alive (Trost, or “capture” expeditions): each adds research points and opens biology studies.

death.cause.devore: devoured by the inheritor of their Titan
shifter.curse: The thirteen years of their power have run out: the Curse of Ymir claims them.
shifter.inherit_command: Inheritance ordered by the high command: the inheritor received the serum and devoured the shifter.
why.shifter_curse: Curse of Ymir: duration of the power
log.shifter.lost: {who} has died without being devoured: the power of the {titan} passes to an unknown Eldian newborn.
shifter.csq_clock: {who} has only {years} years left to live
shifter.csq_close: Stress of {who}, close to the inheritor: +{n}
shifter.csq_newborn: The power is reborn in an Eldian newborn, out of reach
shifter.err.no_holder: The Titan has no living shifter to devour.
shifter.err.not_held: The shifter is not in Paradis's hands.
shifter.err.heir_dead: The designated inheritor is not alive.
shifter.err.same: The shifter cannot inherit from themselves.
shifter.err.not_ours: This Titan has no living shifter in the service of Paradis.
shifter.lock.royal: Locked: control of Pure Titans requires a shifter of royal blood or contact with a royal descendant.
battle.shifter.defeated: {titan} down: the nape is cut, {name} is torn from the body.
battle.shifter.exhausted: {titan} exhausted: {name} emerges from the disintegrating body.
battle.shifter.rampage: {name} loses control of the {titan}: it strikes indiscriminately.
battle.shifter.founder: {name} uses the Coordinate: {n} Pure Titans stop fighting.
shifters.closed: No Titan shifters in this scenario.
shifters.serum_why: Doses of serum held by Paradis. One dose is used per prepared inheritance: the inheritor, turned into a Pure Titan, devours the shifter and receives their power. Kenny Ackerman's case provides one.
shifters.founder_open: The Founder's Coordinate: royal contact established; control of Pure Titans is possible.
shifters.lost: Power lost: it is reborn in an unknown Eldian newborn.
shifters.unknown_holder: Unknown shifter: their identity remains to be established (intelligence).
shifters.clock_why: Curse of Ymir: a shifter dies thirteen years after inheriting their power. When the time comes, with no prepared inheritor, the power passes to a random newborn.
shifters.inherit_confirm: {heir} will receive the serum and devour the shifter of the {titan}. They will have thirteen years left to live. Confirm?
shifters.record.hasard: {titan}: {from} dies without being devoured; the power passes to a newborn
shifters.record.relais_marley: {titan}: Marley passes the power to a new inheritor
shifters.trial_note: Outside the campaign, no effect on the game: 18 soldiers in three squads.

shifter.effect.armor: hardened armour over the whole body
shifter.effect.charge: straight-line rush that knocks everything over
shifter.effect.spikes: crystal spikes bursting from the ground
shifter.effect.remote_body: shifter outside the nape, linked remotely
shifter.effect.heat_wave.limits: Chance of burning an enemy in the radius to death: {power} per second. Blades are useless while the steam lasts. Endurance cost on use.

shifter.effect.charge.limits: Chance of knocking down and killing each enemy in the path: {power}.
shifter.effect.hardening.limits: Share of blade damage blocked on the hardened nape: {power}. Costs endurance every second.
shifter.effect.call.limits: Pure Titans in the radius come running ({power}) and devour the nearest shifter, whoever it may be.
shifter.effect.projectiles.limits: Chance of killing each enemy in the impact zone: {power}.
shifter.effect.command_pures.limits: Pure Titans strike {power} times faster while the shifter holds out.
shifter.effect.bite.limits: Chance to kill: {power}; against a shifter, direct damage to the nape, hardening ignored.
shifter.effect.transport.limits: Gas delivered to each soldier in the radius: {power}; blades replaced.
shifter.effect.spikes.limits: Chance of killing each enemy in the zone: {power}.
shifter.effect.remote_body.limits: Damage to the nape divided by {power}.
shifter.effect.melee_titans.limits: Chance of killing a Pure Titan with each blow: {power}.
shifter.effect.regeneration.limits: Regeneration multiplied by {power}; each point restored costs endurance.
shifter.effect.founder_command.limits: Pure Titans in the radius stop fighting. Requires contact with a royal descendant.

evt.854.fort_slava.body: The Beast Titan hurls its projectiles at the Allied Forces fleet that has come to lift the siege of Fort Slava. The ships sink one after another; the coastal bastion holds. The Mid-East War is drawing to a close.
evt.854.fort_slava.choice.victoire_marle: The war ends in Marley's victory
evt.854.fort_slava.choice.resistance_all: The Allies hold and the war goes on
evt.854.operation_paradis.body: Zeke proposes to the high command that the Founder be retaken before the nations of the world catch up with the power of the Titans. The Tybur family backs his plan and prepares a public announcement in Liberio.
evt.854.liberio_raid.body: At the Liberio festival, Willy Tybur declares war on Paradis before the representatives of the world. Eren transforms in the middle of the crowd and kills Willy; he devours the inheritor of the War Hammer Titan. The Survey Corps strikes the port and the Warriors.
evt.854.liberio_escape.body: The Survey Corps airship tears itself away from Liberio under fire. Zeke joins Paradis, where he is immediately placed under watch.
evt.854.yeagerist_coup.body: Eren's supporters assassinate Commander-in-Chief Zackly. The Yeagerists take control of the army; Pixis briefly assumes command.
evt.854.marley_counterattack.body: Marley's airships drop their troops on Shiganshina. Pixis and Nile, turned into Pure Titans, die in the battle.

menu.summary.scn_sandbox_845: Shiganshina has just fallen. Refugees, famine, reconquest: hold behind Rose.
menu.summary.scn_sandbox_850: Five years after the fall of Maria, the 104th Training Corps leaves camp. Trost is on the eve of its breach; at the end of the road lie the truth, the sea and the world.
menu.summary.scn_854: The outside world is known. Marley turns towards Paradis; Hizuru hesitates; the Allies count their dead.
menu.nation.fac_paradis: Govern the island: army, cabinet, shifters, and now the world.
menu.nation.fac_marley: Lead the empire: fronts, fleets, Warriors, and the Founder to retake.

narr.paradis.event.1: {title}. In the districts, people keep informed through the notices posted on the barracks gates.
narr.paradis.event.2: {title}. The Cabinet has made no statement; families are waiting for news.

narr.marley.event.1: {title}. The Liberio authorities remind the public that the Eldians of the internment zone remain under watch.
narr.marley.event.2: {title}. The Tybur family calls on the nation to unite.

narr.marley.quiet: The Empire is readying its forces; the factories run without respite.

evt.fond.pol_registre_audiences.body: The council's registry publishes the season's register of hearings: over a thousand petitions heard, most of them on matters of bread.
evt.fond.pol_impot_retard.body: Tax collectors report that the taxes from {province} are arriving two weeks late, and no one can say why.
evt.fond.pol_discours_place.body: An orator harangues the square of {province} for an hour against the privileges of the notables; the crowd applauds, then goes home for lunch.
evt.fond.pol_ordonnance_marches.body: The council has it posted that the weights and measures of {province}'s markets will be inspected before the end of the month.
evt.fond.pol_visite_inspecteur.body: A council inspector tours {province}, notebook in hand; the offices tidy away their files for his arrival.
evt.fond.pol_audience_paysans.body: The council holds a public hearing: peasants set out their debts before uneasy notables.
evt.fond.pol_banquet_notables.body: A notables' banquet in {province} goes on late into the night; the servants talk about it more than the guests.
evt.fond.pol_lettre_pasteur.body: A pastor writes to the council to lament the state of the chapel in {province}, whose roof lets in the rain.
evt.fond.pol_accord_guildes.body: Two guilds of {province} agree to share a repair job, after three months of quarrelling.
evt.fond.pol_bureaux_remanies.body: The council redistributes offices among its secretaries; the corridors buzz with promotions and disappointments.
evt.fond.pol_controle_comptes.body: An audit of accounts uncovers an old addition error in the registers of {province}, with no criminal consequences.
evt.fond.pol_pension_veuves.body: The council reviews the pensions of soldiers' widows; the discussion is brief, the list of names is long.
evt.fond.cab_ordre_du_jour.body: Two councillors quarrel over the session's agenda; the meeting begins an hour late.
evt.fond.cab_querelle_voirie.body: The roads budget divides the cabinet: one wants to repair the northern roads, the other the eastern ones.
evt.fond.cab_presidence_commission.body: The chair of a council committee is decided by a single vote, and the loser leaves the room without a word to anyone.
evt.fond.cab_note_egaree.body: A confidential cabinet note has ended up on the wrong desk; no one says a word, but everyone already knows what it says.
evt.fond.cab_preseance.body: The councillors' seating around the table becomes an affair of state for an entire morning.
evt.fond.cab_alliance_couloir.body: Two rival councillors join forces against a third over the granary reform; the agreement will not last, people whisper.
evt.fond.cab_demission_retiree.body: A councillor tenders his resignation in the morning and withdraws it before dinner, for want of a successor to his liking.
evt.fond.cab_deux_chiffres.body: Two departments hand the cabinet conflicting figures on the grain reserves; they will have to be reconciled before the next session.
evt.fond.cab_vote_nul.body: A cabinet motion fails on a tied vote; the chairman of the session defers it to the following week.
evt.fond.cab_seance_interminable.body: The cabinet session runs into the night to settle the price of timber; several councillors doze off.
evt.fond.cab_secretaire_zele.body: A cabinet secretary corrects a councillor's speech in red ink, and the councillor takes it very badly.
evt.fond.cab_reconciliation.body: Two councillors at odds for a year find themselves at the same banquet table and end up raising a glass together.
evt.fond.fam_jumeaux.body: A midwife in {province} announces the birth of twins in an already full house; the neighbours bring linen.
evt.fond.fam_mariage_village.body: A wedding brings all of {province} together: bread is shared, the bell rings twice.
evt.fond.fam_veillee_aieul.body: An old man of {province} passes away at ninety, surrounded by four generations; the wake lasts until dawn.
evt.fond.fam_orphelins.body: A family in {province} takes in two soldiers' orphans; the neighbours promise to help them through the winter.
evt.fond.fam_querelle_heritage.body: Two brothers in {province} fight over a field of little value, all the way to the justice of the peace.
evt.fond.fam_retour_fils.body: A son who left to serve in the Garrison is granted leave and comes home to {province}; the whole street comes to see him.
evt.fond.fam_lettre_mere.body: A mother in {province} dictates a letter for her soldier son to the public scribe; the queue behind her is long.
evt.fond.fam_bapteme.body: A baptism in {province} draws cousins and neighbours; there is more eating than praying.
evt.fond.fam_maitre_ecole.body: The schoolmaster of {province} asks for new slates; the children, for their part, ask for holidays.
evt.fond.fam_soupe_aieule.body: In a kitchen in {province}, a soup is being made from a recipe never written down; everyone swears it never changes.
evt.fond.fam_fiancailles_rompues.body: An engagement is broken off in {province} over a question of dowry; the two families no longer greet each other.
evt.fond.fam_jeux_neige.body: The children of {province} build a rampart of snow and defend it with snowballs against those of the neighbouring quarter.
evt.fond.fam_apprenti.body: An apprentice is placed with a blacksmith in {province}; his father paid for the first months in sacks of flour.
evt.fond.fam_veuve_boutique: A widow takes over the shop
evt.fond.fam_veuve_boutique.body: A widow in {province} takes over her husband's shop and keeps its accounts better than he did; the neighbours grudgingly admit it.
evt.fond.rum_voyageur.body: A traveller passing through {province} tells of things seen far away; no one knows whether to believe him.
evt.fond.rum_prix_beurre.body: Word goes round {province} that butter will be rationed; the shops are emptied before noon.
evt.fond.rum_etoile_filante.body: A shooting star crosses the sky over {province}; some see an omen in it, others a pebble.
evt.fond.rum_garnison_deplacee.body: It is said that the garrison of {province} is to be moved; the garrison knows nothing of it and is worried.
evt.fond.rum_tresor_enfoui.body: An old tale of treasure buried under a barn in {province} resurfaces; the curious dig at night.
evt.fond.rum_taxe_fenetres: A tax that does not exist
evt.fond.rum_taxe_fenetres.body: There is talk of a tax on windows; the council denies it, which only half convinces.
evt.fond.rum_guerisseur.body: A travelling healer, they say, cures fever in three days; the queue in front of his caravan grows longer in {province}.
evt.fond.rum_courrier_perdu.body: A mailbag is reported lost on the road to {province}; everyone swears they were expecting a letter just then.
evt.fond.rum_chanson_nouvelle.body: A song about the Garrison is going round the inns of {province}; the words change from one table to the next.
evt.fond.rum_prophete.body: A crossroads prophet predicts the end of the world for Thursday; Thursday gone, he predicts it for Sunday.
evt.fond.rum_vieille_carte.body: A pedlar in {province} sells a hand-drawn map; it is wrong almost everywhere, but very pretty.
evt.fond.rum_nouvelles_foire.body: At the {province} fair, news of the kingdom comes in three versions, depending on which table you sit at.
evt.fond.rum_cheval_blanc.body: A stray white horse is spotted on the outskirts of {province}; it is said to be masterless, then stolen, then gone.
evt.fond.rum_ombre_toit.body: Children in {province} swear they saw a shadow on the chapel roof; the sexton finds only a cat.
evt.fond.rec_semailles.body: Sowing begins around {province} under a still-cool sky; every farm counts its seed with care.
evt.fond.rec_gel_tardif.body: A late frost burns the young shoots in several orchards of {province}.
evt.fond.rec_degel.body: The thaw turns the roads of {province} into a quagmire; convoys advance a league a day.
evt.fond.rec_pluie_bienvenue.body: A summer rain finally falls on {province} after three weeks of drought; people go out into the yard to watch it.
evt.fond.rec_fenaison.body: Haymaking takes up all of {province}; people sleep in the barns so as not to lose a day of fine weather.
evt.fond.rec_orage_bles.body: A dry storm raises fears for the wheat of {province}, but the hail passes by.
evt.fond.rec_pommes.body: Apples are being picked in {province}; crates pile up in front of the barns.
evt.fond.rec_battage.body: Threshing is in full swing in {province}; golden dust settles on the roofs.
evt.fond.rec_champignons.body: In {province}, families come back from the woods with full baskets; a good soup is promised for the week.
evt.fond.rec_brouillard.body: A thick fog covers {province} three mornings in a row; carters walk ahead of their animals.
evt.fond.rec_premieres_neiges.body: The first snows cover {province}; the children are delighted, the carters much less so.
evt.fond.rec_grand_froid.body: A sharp cold grips {province}; wood is burnt faster than expected.
evt.fond.rec_marche_hiver.body: The winter market of {province} offers mostly turnips and preserves; people haggle in good humour.
evt.fond.rec_surplus_lait.body: The dairymen of {province} struggle to sell off a milk surplus; the cheesemaker has never seen so many pails.
evt.fond.rec_renard_poulaillers.body: A fox prowls around the henhouses of {province}; the farmers keep watch in turns.
evt.fond.rec_moulin_brise.body: The wheel of the {province} mill breaks; the miller promises to repair it before the next milling.
evt.fond.mur_fissure_surface.body: A maintenance team spots a superficial crack in the Wall; it is filled in two days.
evt.fond.mur_vigies_doublees.body: The lookouts on the Wall are doubled for a week, with no explanation other than a written order.
evt.fond.mur_fausse_alarme.body: The alarm bell rings by mistake: an apprentice knocked into it climbing the stairs. People laugh, then apologise.
evt.fond.mur_titan_immobile.body: A lone Titan stands for hours at the foot of the Wall; the lookouts never take their eyes off it.
evt.fond.mur_badigeon.body: A lime crew whitewashes a section of the Wall; the scaffolding traces curious silhouettes.
evt.fond.mur_corbeaux.body: Flocks of crows settle on the Wall; the soldiers chase them off, they come back.
evt.fond.mur_echelle_rouillee.body: An access ladder on the Wall gives way under a soldier, who escapes with a sprained ankle.
evt.fond.mur_treuils_graisses.body: The gate winches are greased before the season; the creaking has stopped for a while.
evt.fond.mur_ronde_nuit.body: The night rounds on the Wall come across a fox and a lost patrol; nothing else to report.
evt.fond.mur_eboulis_talus: Rockfall at the foot of the Wall
evt.fond.mur_eboulis_talus.body: A rockfall briefly blocks the road at the foot of the Wall; a work detail clears the way.
evt.fond.mur_essai_canon.body: The Wall gunners test a piece; the shot rattles the windows of the lower town.
evt.fond.mur_odeur_gaz.body: A smell of gas alarms the barracks; a badly tightened pipe is to blame.
evt.fond.mur_curieux: Onlookers at the foot of the Wall
evt.fond.mur_curieux.body: On Sundays, residents go up to the foot of the Wall to look out over the plain; the guards let them, at a distance.
evt.fond.mur_maitre_macon.body: A master mason examines the base of the Wall with a mallet and concludes that the stone is sound.
evt.fond.mil_exercice_aube.body: The recruits of {province} are dragged out of bed before dawn for a drill in perfect lines; the sergeant counts the latecomers.
evt.fond.mil_soupe_froide.body: The soup at the {province} barracks arrives cold three days running; the complaint goes all the way up to the quartermaster.
evt.fond.mil_remise_galons.body: A brief ceremony awarding stripes takes place in {province}, without fanfare, before somewhat weary ranks.
evt.fond.mil_inventaire_lames.body: The quartermasters count the spare blades in {province} and find a few fewer than expected.
evt.fond.mil_cheval_boiteux.body: A horse at the {province} barracks is lame; the farrier spends the morning on it.
evt.fond.mil_marche_endurance.body: The {province} garrison makes a ten-league endurance march; the boots will remember it.
evt.fond.mil_permissions.body: A round of leave is granted in {province} after a month without incident; the inns get ready.
evt.fond.mil_bagarre_auberge.body: A brawl between soldiers and workers breaks out in an inn in {province}; the provost draws up three reports.
evt.fond.mil_tir_entrainement.body: Firing practice takes place near {province}; the neighbouring peasants bring their animals in as a precaution.
evt.fond.mil_depot_range.body: The {province} depot is put back in order by a team over three days; forgotten crates turn up.
evt.fond.mil_recit_veteran.body: A veteran tells the recruits of {province} about his greatest frights; the recruits listen, wide-eyed.
evt.fond.mil_cours_du_soir.body: The Training Corps opens an evening reading class for the recruits of {province}; a few of them fall asleep in it.
evt.845.shiganshina_breach.body: A Colossal Titan appears above Shiganshina and breaks the outer gate of Wall Maria. Titans enter the district; the lower town is the first to be hit.
evt.845.wall_maria_gate.body: A second, armoured attacker smashes through the inner gate. The Titans spread across the Maria ring, which becomes a lost zone.
evt.845.royal_family_massacre.body: That day, far from any eyes, the royal family is massacred. Frieda Reiss dies; the power of the Founder passes to Grisha Yeager, then to Eren. Only Rod Reiss survives.
evt.845.retreat_to_rose.body: The survivors fall back towards Wall Rose. A decision must be made: open all the gates or limit entry; the influx of refugees begins and tension rises between Rose and Sina.
evt.845.refugee_crisis.body: Thousands of refugees crowd into the Rose ring: local famine, crime, epidemics. The legitimacy of the government suffers.
evt.846.reclamation.body: For lack of food, the government sends part of the population to reclaim the lands of Maria. The losses are massive; the exact figure remains uncertain.
evt.846.famine.body: Scarcity follows: strict rationing, black market, unrest in the poor quarters. The guilds see an opportunity to make themselves useful.
evt.847.104th_recruitment.body: Around 847, a new class of recruits, the 104th, enters the Training Corps. The quality of the school depends on what the kingdom is willing to invest in it.
evt.850.yeager_basement.body: In the cellar of the Yeager house, in Shiganshina, books reveal the existence of a world beyond the seas.
evt.850.wall_maria_cleanup.body: The Titans still occupying the Maria ring are eliminated. The resettlement of towns and roads begins; the operation lasts about nine months.
evt.850.ocean.body: At the end of the coast, the ocean is discovered: a horizon of salt water that no one on Paradis had ever seen. Ports and relations with the outside become possible.
evt.851.marley_fleet.body: Marley's ships reconnoitre the coasts of Paradis. On board are Anti-Marleyan Volunteers.
evt.851.volunteers.body: The Anti-Marleyan Volunteers, who arrived with the fleet, offer their help: serums, information, contacts outside. Yelena and Onyankopon are among them.
evt.851.hizuru_visit.body: A delegation from Hizuru makes contact with Paradis. The first trade talks open, and with them a railway project.
evt.851.eren_departure.body: Eren leaves Paradis to infiltrate Marley's army.
evt.851.middle_east_war.body: Marley fights the Allied Forces in a distant war. Tension rises between Marley and Hizuru.
evt.853.hizuru_refusal.body: Hizuru refuses open trade and keeps the monopoly on Paradis's resources for itself. The island remains isolated.
evt.851.marley_ships_lost.body: Marley's reconnaissance ships do not return. Marley realises that Paradis holds at least two Titans.
evt.854.rumbling.body: The Titans of the Walls are released and begin to march: the Rumbling is unleashed. The whole world is threatened.
evt.854.heaven_earth_battle.body: The final reckoning: those who oppose the Rumbling try to stop it. Hange Zoë dies there; several endings are possible.
evt.850.marley_antititan_rifle.body: Marley develops rifles capable of troubling Titans and their shifters. Their use will be observed later.
chrono.intel_why: What your agents and cross-checked reports let you know of what is coming. Without intelligence, nothing is announced; with rumours, you can guess; with forecasts, you know the event and its month; with certainties, its date.
chrono.none: Nothing to show for this filter.
chrono.ecart_line: This decision departs from the known story: deviation
chrono.conforme_line: In line with the known story.
chrono.hook_summary: The file is open; its outcome depends on your decisions.
chrono.rumor_summary: It is whispered that something is afoot. Nothing specific is known.
chrono.rumor.politique.0: Whispered conferences stir the corridors of power.
chrono.rumor.politique.1: There is talk of a decision being prepared in high places.
chrono.rumor.militaire.0: Troop movements are mentioned in the barracks.
chrono.rumor.militaire.1: The general staffs speak in low voices of an order to come.
chrono.rumor.titans.0: Lookouts say they have seen something troubling near the Walls.
chrono.rumor.titans.1: Bad news from the Walls is already going round the inns.
chrono.rumor.famille.0: A family affair is stirring the influential houses.
chrono.rumor.famille.1: There are whispers of a house secret that should never have got out.
chrono.rumor.monde.0: Travellers bring news from distant lands.
chrono.rumor.monde.1: Troubling rumours are circulating about what is happening far from here.

army.err.no_route: No passable route (the Walls can only be crossed at the gates).
army.err.engaged: This army is in contact with the enemy.
army.err.not_coast: The fleet must be anchored off this coast.
army.err.not_embarked: This army is not on board.
army.err.static: These batteries do not leave the rampart.
army.err.not_visible: This army is not in sight.
army.err.no_retreat: No province to fall back to.
army.err.not_together: Both armies must be in the same province.
army.err.split_all: The army must keep at least one regiment.
army.err.general: This character cannot command this army.
army.err.general_busy: This general already commands an army.
army.err.already_raised: The armies have already been raised.
army.err.cannot_play: This encounter cannot be played as a battle.

army.general_fell: Fell at the head of their troops
army.general_fell_battle: Fell in battle at the head of their army
battle.death.eclat: {name} ({squad}) is killed by a shell splinter.
armies.choose_confirm: Designate {name} to succeed the supreme commander?
armies.march_losses_why: Men lost outside battle since departure: wear from forced marching, famine for lack of provisions, coastal bombardment by an enemy fleet, Titans of the plains, shipwrecks. An exhausted army (fatigue 100%) stops its forced march of its own accord.
armies.fatigue_why: It rises on the march and falls when halted. On a normal march, it caps at {cap}% and does not slow the army; beyond that (forced march), it slows the army and weighs on it in combat.
armies.men_why: Men present: the regiments' regulation strength, reduced by losses, hunger and the wear of forced marching.
armies.morale_why: It returns towards {base} at rest; victories, defeats, hunger and the loss of the general make it vary. Below {rout}, the army breaks and falls back of its own accord.
armies.pick: Choose a destination on the map
armies.succession_text: Supreme command is vacant. Appoint a successor before the factions do it for you.
armies.supply_why: Days of food and gas carried (at most {max}). In a held province, the army draws on national stocks; in enemy country, it lives on its reserves, then goes hungry.

mission.mis_mil_inventaire_garnisons.des: Count the men, weapons and gas at every post on the Wall, to know what can be relied on.
mission.mis_mil_reforme_armee.desc: Unify the command, ranks and pay of the three branches so that they act as a single army.
mission.mis_mil_corps_instruction.desc: Lengthen trainees' instruction and double the number of instructors at the training camp.
mission.mis_mil_ecole_cadres.desc: Train officers able to lead a squad alone in the fog and bring their men back.
mission.mis_mil_manoeuvres_odm.desc: Train every squad to fly while saving gas and to choose its anchor points.
mission.mis_mil_veille_nuit.desc: Double the lookouts and set the signals for marches that run on after dusk.
mission.mis_mil_service_sanitaire.desc: Assign doctors and nurses to every squad and every convoy, with field equipment.
mission.mis_mil_ateliers_entretien.desc: Repair, grease and reuse equipment instead of replacing it after every campaign.
mission.mis_mil_canons_rempart.desc: Overhaul the fixed guns on the Walls, add more at the crossing points and train gun crews.
mission.mis_mil_batteries_mobiles.desc: Mount cannons on wheeled carriages so that they can follow expeditions beyond the Walls.
mission.mis_mil_postes_avances.desc: Fortify relay posts where expeditions can fall back, resupply and leave their wounded.
mission.mis_mil_patrouilles_mur.desc: Keep the wall-walks patrolled day and night, with regular reliefs.
mission.mis_mil_haras_relais.desc: Breed more horses and spread them along the expedition routes, with post relays.
mission.mis_mil_convois_escortes.desc: Escort every convoy with a mounted section and set safe stages.
mission.mis_mil_defense_profondeur.desc: Spread the garrisons over several lines rather than packing them at the foot of the ramparts.
mission.mis_mil_etude_anti_titan.desc: Bring together officers, doctors and craftsmen to understand how Titans fall and how to kill them at lower cost.
mission.mis_eco_recensement_greniers.des: Count the grain stocks of every district and record what is lost there each year.
mission.mis_eco_greniers_publics.desc: Build large ventilated granaries so that grain stops rotting in storage.
mission.mis_eco_mines_forges.desc: Open new galleries and bring the forges of the mining hills back into service.
mission.mis_eco_fabriques_gaz.desc: Enlarge the gas works and secure their tanks.
mission.mis_eco_routes_marchandes.desc: Maintain the roads between the districts and set fair tolls.
mission.mis_eco_rotation_cultures.desc: Teach the farmers of the plain a rotation that wears out the soil less.
mission.mis_eco_poudrieres.desc: Build powder magazines away from the towns and train explosives specialists.
mission.mis_pol_audiences_districts.desc: Have the council sit in the districts to hear complaints in person.
mission.mis_pol_reforme_cabinet.desc: Fix the agenda, the chairing of sessions and the drafting of the cabinet's decisions.
mission.mis_pol_cabinet_de_guerre.desc: A small committee settles military matters quickly, at the cost of less oversight of the police.
mission.mis_pol_reforme_fiscale.desc: Replace arbitrary levies with a written scale; the merchants grumble, the peasants breathe easier.
mission.mis_pol_tribunaux_civils.desc: Entrust ordinary disputes to civil judges rather than to the barracks.
mission.mis_pol_police_reglee.desc: Bind the Military Police by written rules and inspections.
mission.mis_rel_dialogue_culte: Dialogue with the Cult of the Walls
mission.mis_rel_dialogue_culte.desc: Receive the Cult's leaders and agree on what may be told to the faithful.
mission.mis_rel_eglise_des_murs: Church of the Walls: status and privileges
mission.mis_rel_eglise_des_murs.desc: Grant the Cult lands, exemptions and a place at public ceremonies.
mission.mis_rel_sermons_ordre.desc: Ask the priests to preach calm and patience in times of scarcity.
mission.mis_rel_tolerance_courants.desc: Let the groups who read the texts differently live in peace; the Cult will see it as an affront.
mission.mis_rel_hospices_charite.desc: Open hospices for the sick, the elderly and orphans.
mission.mis_ren_reseau_informateurs.desc: Recruit correspondents in the markets, the post relays and the barracks.
mission.mis_ren_contre_espionnage.desc: Watch the mail, the depots and newcomers to the barracks.
mission.mis_ren_archives_police.desc: Gather the scattered files of the police stations and sort them by case.
mission.mis_ren_reseau_signaux.desc: Set up signal towers linked to one another from one end of the Walls to the other.
mission.mis_mil_avant_pays_reconnaissanc: Send squads to survey the roads, fords and ruins beyond Wall Maria.
mission.mis_mil_premiere_reprise: Retaking the first belt of land
mission.mis_mil_premiere_reprise.desc: Methodically clear the lands near the Wall to reopen roads and fields there.
mission.mis_eco_defrichement.desc: Win fields from the waste land near the southern districts.
mission.mis_eco_marche_central.desc: Bring the market halls together into one supervised market where prices are posted.
mission.mis_eco_entrepots_trost.desc: Build vast warehouses at the southern gate to store grain and gas.
mission.mis_mil_vigie_tours.desc: Raise the watchtowers to see farther across the plain.
mission.mis_mil_preparatifs_reconquete.d: Gather men, gas and food behind the remaining Walls to retake the lost lands one day.
mission.mis_mil_reconquete_maria.desc: Retake the lands of Maria, district after district: clear, resupply, fortify. A task of more than a year.
mission.mis_mil_consolidation_maria.desc: Install garrisons, granaries and roads in the retaken lands so that they can hold on their own.
mission.mis_mil_ravitaillement_terres_re: Set up food and gas depots along the road to Maria.
mission.mis_pol_ordre_apres_crise.desc: Get the courts, markets and distributions running again in the stricken districts.
Rebuild the works of the southern gate and reinforce its garrison.
mission.mis_ren_chasse_infiltres.desc: Sift through the corps' registers and recent arrivals to spot false names.
mission.mis_mil_lances_foudroyantes.desc: Mass-produce the explosive-charge spear and train squads in its use.
mission.mis_mil_programme_capture.desc: Assign squads to capturing live Titans for study.
mission.mis_mil_scellement_breches.desc: Extend to other works the technique that was used to plug a breach.
mission.mis_eco_chantiers_refugies.desc: Employ refugees in rebuilding roads, warehouses and ramparts.
mission.mis_pol_commission_reconstructio: Give a cabinet commission the powers to repair the damaged districts.
mission.mis_mon_veille_rivages.desc: Post lookouts on the cliffs of the east coast, with orders to report any unknown vessel.
mission.mis_mon_releves_cote.desc: Chart the coves, cliffs and currents near the island.
mission.mis_mon_archives_exterieur.desc: Gather everything the archives, confessions and remains can tell of the world beyond the sea.
mission.mis_mil_corps_expeditionnaire.de: Raise an elite corps equipped for a distant campaign, with its batteries, horses and convoys.
mission.mis_mil_defense_cote.desc: Arm the south-eastern cliffs with long-range guns against ships and their shells.
mission.mis_mil_lances_ameliorees.desc: Lighten the thunder spears, make their fuse more reliable and train squads to fire them in pairs.
mission.mis_mil_invasion_marley.desc: Gather transport ships, landing forces, maps and food to carry the war to the enemy. A task of more than a year.
mission.mis_mil_mobilisation_generale.de: Recall the reservists and open the barracks to volunteers, at the cost of order in the districts.
mission.mis_mon_contact_hizuru.desc: Open regular correspondence with Hizuru's envoys and agree on what each side owes the other.
mission.mis_mon_garanties_hizuru.desc: Offer written guarantees and trade priorities to persuade Hizuru not to side with Marley.
mission.mis_mon_liaison_volontaires.desc: Set up an office to receive, house and listen to the volunteers from abroad.
mission.mis_ren_renseignement_marley.des: Gather from the volunteers and the archives everything needed to prepare a campaign: ports, garrisons, railway lines.
mission.mis_eco_economie_de_guerre.desc: Turn the forges and works over to weapons, even if it means rationing everything else.
mission.mis_pol_union_nationale.desc: Rally the cabinet, the court, the Cult and the corps around a common war programme.
mission.mis_marley_mobilisation_industri: Requisition factories and workshops for war production.
Extend the age classes called up and reorganise the recruit depots.
mission.mis_marley_arsenaux.desc: Enlarge the arsenals and double the assembly lines for artillery pieces.
mission.mis_marley_corps_expeditionnaire: Organise an elite corps able to conduct a distant campaign.
mission.mis_marley_flotte_transport.desc: Fit out transports and escorts for a landing.
mission.mis_marley_securite_interieure.d: Strengthen the police and the surveillance of the internment zones.
mission.mis_marley_propagande_guerre.des: Posters, newspapers and speeches to support the war effort.
Recruit informants and brokers to learn the enemy's intentions.
mission.mis_marley_contre_espionnage.des: Track down agents infiltrated into the services and the factories.
mission.mis_marley_pression_hizuru.desc: Use trade and threats to weigh on Hizuru's choice.
mission.mis_marley_accord_allies.desc: Negotiate a sharing of tasks and supplies with the Allies.
mission.mis_marley_campagne_de_paradis.d: Settle the order of battle, the ports of departure and the objectives of a great campaign.
evt.mis.revue_postes.body: The inventory is complete: every post on the Wall knows its men, its gas and its weapons, and the barracks registers finally agree.
evt.mis.promotion_cadres.body: The first officers from the officers' school join their squads. The veterans watch them with suspicion at first, then with respect.
evt.mis.audience_districts.body: The council has sat in three districts. The most frequent complaints concern the price of bread and the housing of displaced families.
evt.mis.greniers_ouverts.body: The new granaries open their doors: the carters find clear docks, up-to-date registers and dry grain.
evt.mis.procession_murs.body: A procession crosses the district under the banners of the Cult of the Walls. The faithful thank the priests; others count the candles.
evt.mis.carte_reseau.body: The first correspondents send news from markets and post relays. Most of it is of no interest; a few items are worth their weight in gold.
evt.mis.convoi_arrive.body: A batch of trained horses arrives at the forward posts. The riders swear the grey mare is like no other.
evt.mis.chantier_remparts.body: The masons have rebuilt a stretch of the wall-walk and carved the date into the stone. The sergeant of the guard declares himself satisfied.
evt.mis.dilemme_batteries: Where to place the first batteries?
evt.mis.dilemme_batteries.body: The artillery commission proposes two sites for the first mobile batteries. The north is poorly defended; the south sees the convoys pass.
evt.mis.dilemme_batteries.choice.nord: In the north, near the isolated posts
evt.mis.dilemme_batteries.choice.sud: In the south, on the convoy route
evt.mis.dilemme_reforme: The old guard contests the reform
evt.mis.dilemme_reforme.body: Officers of the old school refuse to sign the new organisation of the corps and demand that their customs be kept.
evt.mis.dilemme_reconquete.body: Away from the roads, the scouts have found an intact hamlet: barns, wells, a few orchards gone wild again.
evt.mis.dilemme_reconquete.choice.invent: Survey the site and press on
evt.mis.dilemme_culte.body: The Cult of the Walls offers to run the hospices in exchange for a say over their registers. The doctors hesitate.

tuto.title: Getting started guide
tuto.accueil.corps: You govern Paradis Island, behind its three Walls. In a few steps, this guide presents what you need to know to lead your first month. Time stands still while you read. You may leave the guide at any time; it will remain available in the options.
tuto.carte.action: Drag the map with the mouse, then turn the wheel to zoom.
tuto.carte.corps: Each territory on the island is a province. The three Walls separate Maria, Rose and Sina. The further you zoom in, the more detail the map shows: names, garrisons, armies.
tuto.province.action: Click a province to open its file.
tuto.province.corps: The file gives the province's population, garrison, buildings and resources. Every figure is explained: hover over it to see where it comes from.
tuto.ressources.corps: The top bar shows your reserves: food, gas, steel, powder, gold… Hover over a figure to see what makes it rise or fall. Morale, legitimacy and political capital count as much as stocks.
tuto.temps.action: Start time with the speed 1 button on the top bar (or the {key} key).
tuto.temps.corps: One day passes with each step. Space pauses; keys 1 to 5 set the speed. The game stops by itself when an important alert occurs. Time has just been paused again to let you read.
tuto.economie.action: Open Economy from the bottom menu ({key} key).
tuto.economie.corps: For each resource: what comes in, what goes out and the daily balance. A resource that runs out soon leads to losses of morale: watch negative balances before supplies run dry.
tuto.armees.action: Open Armies from the bottom menu ({key} key).
tuto.armees.corps: Your armies, their strength, their supplies and their position. To give a marching order, select an army, then click the destination on the map.
tuto.cabinet.action: Open the Cabinet from the bottom menu ({key} key).
tuto.cabinet.corps: Your ministers vote on the decrees you put to them. A forecast of the vote is shown before the decision, with each minister's reasons. Overriding a veto costs political capital.
tuto.recherche.action: Open the Research Office from the bottom menu ({key} key).
tuto.recherche.corps: Technologies form a tree. Choose a study: research points accumulate each month, and the next study opens once its prerequisites are completed.
tuto.missions.action: Open Missions from the bottom menu ({key} key).
tuto.missions.corps: Missions are objectives lasting several months, by domain: military, politics, economy, religion, intelligence, outside world. Each one costs resources at launch and brings its bonuses on completion. Hover over a card to see its effects.
tuto.evenements.action: Open the Timeline from the bottom menu ({key} key).
tuto.evenements.corps: The timeline brings together past events, ongoing ones and those your intelligence lets you foresee. When a decision is awaited, a file opens: read it, then choose before the deadline.
tuto.expeditions.action: Open Expeditions from the bottom menu ({key} key).
tuto.expeditions.corps: This is where sorties beyond the Walls are prepared: route, manpower, food. At the bottom of the register, the trial battle lets you practise with no consequence for your game.
tuto.bataille.corps: Your soldiers and the Titans clash on a tactical map. Pause to think, select squads and give them orders. A trial battle has no consequence for your game.
tuto.bataille.attente: Close the battle with the “Close” button to continue the guide.
tuto.fin.corps: The guide is over. Discreet hints will appear the first time you open a register; they can be turned off in the options, where the guide can also be replayed. May your reign be a good one.

manual.title: Manual
manual.but.title: The aim of the game
manual.but.body:
Walls and Blood is a grand strategy game. You govern Paradis Island behind its three Walls (or the Marleyan Empire in the 854 scenario): feed the population, hold the Walls, govern a divided kingdom, venture out to explore, then face the outside world.
Four scenarios: 845, after the fall of Wall Maria (hold behind Rose, regain a foothold); 850, from Trost to the ocean (the chronicle of the 104th Training Corps, up to the truth and the sea); 854, the war against Marley (played as Paradis or as Marley); 854, the Rumbling (a short crisis with the world at stake).
Each scenario has its objectives, its defeats and its term, which can be consulted at any time in the Epilogue register.
The chronicle follows the known facts of the universe as long as your choices do not lead it astray (see “Events and chronicle”).
manual.temps.title: Time
manual.temps.body:
The game advances day by day. You can give your orders while paused: they take effect as soon as time resumes.
The game pauses by itself when an important alert occurs: a decision awaited, a battle, an expedition's return, a character's death, a shortage, an enemy landing…
An automatic save is made every thirty days of game time.
manual.temps.keys: Keys: {pause} pause; {slow} to {fast} speeds, from slowest to fastest.
manual.carte.title: The map
manual.carte.body:
Each territory is a province; the three Walls separate Maria, Rose and Sina. The further you zoom in, the more detail the map shows: names, garrisons, armies, roads.
Click a province to open its file: population, garrison, buildings, resources, morale and stability. Every figure is explained: hover over it, or follow the “Why?” link, to see where it comes from.
Layers colour the map according to one type of data: politics, morale, food, gas, Titans, population, religion, legitimacy, supply, intelligence; a legend accompanies them. With the outside world in play, the world atlas shows the nations, the fronts and the seas.
manual.carte.keys: Keys: {zin} and {zout} zoom; arrows to move; {world}, {region} and {province} detail levels; {fit} reframe; {layer} next layer, {off} no layer.
manual.registres.title: The registers
manual.registres.body:
The management menu sorts the registers by domain: government, army, research, intelligence, diplomacy, world. Each register opens with a click or with its key, and closes with Esc.
A register appears only when the scenario has a use for it: diplomacy and the war table exist only with the outside world, and the institutions of Paradis are hidden when you lead Marley.
manual.economie.title: Resources and economy
manual.economie.body:
The top bar shows the reserves: food, gas, steel, Ice Burst Stone, powder, horses, manpower, coal and gold. Hover over a figure to see what makes it rise or fall.
Provinces produce according to their population, their buildings and their situation; the population, the army and expeditions consume. Stocks have a capacity, and a little is lost every day.
The Economy register gives, for each resource, what comes in, what goes out and the daily balance. Reduced rationing (−15% consumption) or strict rationing (−30%) saves food at the cost of morale and productivity.
A food shortage makes morale plummet and kills slowly; low morale lowers stability, and low stability reduces taxes.
manual.politique.title: Governing
manual.politique.body:
Legitimacy measures the acceptance of your rule; political capital is spent to enact decrees, accept proposals or override a veto.
The cabinet votes on the decrees you submit; a forecast of the vote is shown before the decision, with each member's reasons. The council sends you proposals, to accept or reject before their deadline.
Society is made up of strata (royal family, nobility, bourgeoisie, military, clergy of the Walls, peasants, underworld, refugees): each has its own satisfaction and radicalisation. The organisations (Survey Corps, Garrison, Military Police, Cult of the Walls, guilds…) have their leaders and their interests.
Characters live, age and die; their traits and loyalties weigh on votes and events.
manual.armee.title: Armies, missions and research
manual.armee.body:
The Armies register shows your forces, their manpower, their supplies and their position: select an army, then click its destination on the map.
National missions are objectives lasting several months, by domain (military, politics, economy, religion, intelligence, outside world): they cost at launch and pay off on completion.
Research is a tree: one study at a time, points each month, prerequisites, and some paths that exclude others.
The shifter Titans (Shifters register) change the balance of power; those who hold them are subject to the Curse of Ymir.
manual.expeditions.title: Expeditions and battles
manual.expeditions.body:
Sorties beyond the Walls are prepared in the Expeditions register: route (from Karanes, or by clicking the map), manpower, food and horses. On the way, Titan encounters depend on their density, the size of the column, the season and the weather; the report details losses and their causes.
An encounter can open a battle on a tactical map: pause to think, select squads and give them orders. The 3D view is set in the options (view, quality, violence shown).
The trial battle, at the bottom of the register, offers practice with no consequence for the game.
manual.evenements.title: Events and chronicle
manual.evenements.body:
The timeline brings together past events, ongoing ones and those your intelligence lets you foresee. When a decision is awaited, a file opens: read it, then choose before the deadline; if you make no choice, the default option applies.
The Gazette recounts the year; the Archives keep the documents discovered. Intelligence estimates what you cannot see, with a margin of error, and your secrets can leak.
Your choices can lead history away from the known chronicle: the game then enters a divergent branch, and events whose context has disappeared are avoided.
manual.monde.title: The outside world
manual.monde.body:
After the discovery of the continent, the war table shows the nations: Paradis, Marley, Hizuru, the Allies. Each has its own industry, manpower and fronts.
Diplomacy offers trade, non-aggression, intelligence, alliance or peace; Hizuru's neutrality shifts according to your actions, and the Allied coalition votes with three voices. Marley can prepare an invasion by sea: embarkation port, crossing, landing, Titan support.
Every decision of the computer-controlled nations is recorded, with its reasons in figures, in the Diplomacy register.
manual.fins.title: Game endings
manual.fins.body:
The Epilogue register lists the scenario's objectives for your side, their progress, the possible defeats and the term.
A defeat takes precedence; an early victory comes when all its objectives are met; at the term, the game is judged on the objectives met.
At the end, time stops and the epilogue opens with the verdict and the record. You can then carry on in free play: the first verdict is kept.
manual.difficulte.title: Difficulty
manual.difficulte.body:
It is chosen in the menu, before starting a game, and is kept in the save. Story: stronger production, less aggressive Titans and enemies. Normal: the world as the data describes it. Hard and Breach: harder at each step.
Custom: set the production, the number of Titans, the aggressiveness of enemy nations and the losses yourself (from ×0.5 to ×1.5), as well as starting morale and stability (from −20 to +20).
manual.accessibilite.title: Accessibility
manual.accessibilite.body:
The options (F9, or the entry in the main menu) set the interface scale (from 100 to 200%), subtitles for important sounds and every keyboard key.
Colour-blind friendly colours: nation and alert colours are replaced by a palette that can be told apart without red and green. Reduce motion and flashes: animations, shaking and flashes are toned down. Reading aid: plain fonts, more widely spaced text.
These preferences stay in this browser; they never change the game.
manual.sauvegarde.title: Saving
manual.sauvegarde.body:
The game is saved automatically every thirty days of game time, in three rotating slots; “Continue” on the main menu resumes the most recent one.
The console (F2) saves and reloads on demand in a named slot: “save name”, “load name”.
An old save is updated on loading (version migration); a damaged save is refused with a clear message, without touching the game in progress.
